sources.title: Weather Lab | WeatherNext | Google for Developers
sources.snippet: Weather Lab is an interactive website developed by Google DeepMind and Google Research for exploring AI weather forecasts. It provides a map-based interface for visualizing global forecast layers, tracking tropical cyclones with predicted and observed tracks, and downloading experimental cyclone forecast data.
